<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple figure (model figure@1): one large picture with its caption in a figure: the title (it names the
  section), a line and the credit. Axes: layout (wide: the caption centred under the picture, end: the caption
  beside it at the end from md up, start: at the start).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type FigureSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  image?: string;
  imageAlt: string;
  imageSrcset?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  credit?: string;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  layout?: "wide" | "end" | "start";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  image = "",
  imageAlt,
  imageSrcset = "",
  title,
  description = "",
  credit = "",
  padding = "standard",
  layout = "wide",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FigureSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const frame = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "wide" ? "flex flex-col gap-6"
  : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3 md:items-end"
);
const pictureClass = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "wide") ? "" : "md:col-span-2");
const ratio = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "wide") ? "16/9" : "4/3");
const caption = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "wide" ? "mx-auto max-w-2xl"
  : (layout as string) === "start" ? "md:order-first"
  : ""
);
const copyAlign = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "wide") ? "center" : "start");
const copyText = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "wide") ? "text-center" : "text-start");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="figure-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box tag="figure" :class="frame">
        <MediaFrame :alt="imageAlt" :src="image" :srcset="imageSrcset" :ratio="ratio" :class="pictureClass" />
        <Stack gap="2" :align="copyAlign" :class="caption">
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold" :class="copyText" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Text>
          <Text v-if="description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <Text v-if="credit" size="xs" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', copyText)">
            {{ credit }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
